verdict.rationale: sevDesk connects business bank accounts (over 4,000 banks) and lets users map invoices directly to bank payments while flagging missing receipts. This covers matching and part of surfacing unmatched items. missing for 10: an explicit per-account bank-to-ledger reconciliation view, duplicate transaction detection, a documented review queue for matched and unmatched items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: Map invoices directly to your bank payments. See when receipts are missing.
Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk. We already support over 4,000 banks and neobanks.
